{{Quote|Korriban shall be as it always was. A graveyard for the darkest of the Sith Lords, still whispering within their tombs. It shall always be a source of evil, spawning threats throughout the millennia.|[[Kreia|Darth Traya]]|<ref name="tsl">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Korriban''', known as '''Horusar''' and '''Grevid''' as well as '''Pesegam''' during the reign of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] and '''Moraband''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was the sole [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Horuset system]], located across the galaxy from [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]]. It was the original homeworld of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] and a sacred planet for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], housing the tombs for many ancient and powerful [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] and containing immense [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] power.

After the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], the [[Exiles|exiled Dark Jedi]] interbred with the Sith species and ruled the Sith using their [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. After the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Korriban was abandoned and became a barren world. It was the site of a [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Galactic War]], and [[New Sith Wars]] and was the headquarters of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] and [[One Sith]].

It was close to [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]] and was located on the [[Nache Bhelfia]] and [[Kamat Krote]] hyperspace lanes.

==History==
===Infinite Empire===
{{Quote|It is on Korriban that the Sith Purebloods began; it is here that they often return in death.|[[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle|<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Korriban-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Korriban as seen from space.]]
This remote, foreboding planet,<ref name="tsl" /> at one point known as Horusar and Grevid,<ref name="CotG" /> was the original homeworld of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]].<ref name="pena" /> Some time prior to [[200,000 BBY]], the Sith began to build monuments in the [[Valley of Golg]].<ref name="BoS" /> Circa [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]], the Sith began to develop a civilization.<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Circa [[30,000 BBY]], there was a [[Incursion of Korriban|Killik incursion of Korriban]]. The Sith swiftly drove off the insectoid attackers.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Invasion of Korriban|invaded]] Korriban in an attempt to integrate the world into the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] around [[27,700 BBY]].<ref name="pena" /> The Rakata placed a [[Star Map]], around which the [[tomb of Naga Sadow]] would later be built, on Korriban.<ref name="kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

The Rakata were eventually forced off the world after the [[Sith King]] [[Adas]] led his people against them. Adas died in the conflict, and thus, despite this victory, the Sith society crumbled, and, in the ensuing centuries of [[Korriban civil war|strife]], the Sith relocated to worlds such as [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], which became the capital of [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|their empire]],<ref name="pena" /> [[Malachor V]], [[Tund/Legends|Tund]], and [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] using captured Rakatan vessels, leaving Korriban as a graveyard world populated only by religious fanatics.<ref name="TEA" />

Korriban was at least a nominal member of [[Xim's empire]] from around [[25,126 BBY]] until its fall and was given the name Pesegam.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[7000 BBY]], a [[Korriban civil war (Dathka Graush)|civil war]] between [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] and rival Sith leaders devastated most of Korriban's cities.<ref name="TEA" />

===Sith Empire===
{{Quote|But after our ship emerged from hyperspace, we soon arrived on the world you known as Korriban. We were astonished to find that the native Sith were Force-sensitive.|[[Ajunta Pall]]|<ref name="JvS" />}}
[[File:Jedi_exile_JMGD.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Exiles arriving on Korriban.]]
The [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] was founded in [[6900 BBY]] by [[Exiles|exiled]] fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after they lost the [[Battle of Corbos]], which concluded the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The fallen Jedi [[Discovery of Korriban|landed]] on Korriban.<ref name="db">{{DB|organization|thesith|Sith}}</ref>

Using their training in the Force, the fallen Jedi amazed the Sith and elevated themselves to god-like status on Korriban, becoming the rulers of the Sith people. As the years passed, and interbreeding occurred between the Fallen Jedi and the Sith, the term "Sith" came to mean not only the original inhabitants of Korriban, but also their fallen Jedi masters. Until the [[Funeral of Marka Ragnos]], the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were isolated from each other.<ref name="totj2" />

The Sith Lords erected huge palaces and burial complexes to honor their deceased Dark Lords. Circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the planet became an endpoint of the newly-formed [[Daragon Trail]] hyperspace lane, when it was discovered by [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]].<ref name="totj2" /> This event triggered the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="TOTJ:TFOTSE">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]''</ref> After the fall of the Sith Empire, the planet was abandoned<ref name="TEA" /> and fell off galactic starcharts for a thousand years, although rumors of its existence persisted.<ref name="dlots1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>

===Old Sith Wars===
{{Quote|The call of Korriban is strong, but it is the call of the dead.|[[Darth Sion]]|<ref name="tsl" />}}
[[File:Krbn1.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' lifts off from Dreshdae starport, awash in the golden light of a Korriban sunset.]]
In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="nec" /> [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], guided by the ghost of [[Freedon Nadd]], went to Korriban in search of knowledge about the Sith.<ref name="dlots2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref><ref name="dlots3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], disciples of Exar Kun established a [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on Korriban.<ref name="TEA" /> After Kun's death, his disciples maintained the academy and established the settlement of [[Dreshdae]].<ref name="sal">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref> In [[3993 BBY]],<ref name="nec" /> as part of the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], [[Duron Qel-Droma]] and [[Shaela Nuur]] died on the planet, failing to [[Cleansing of Korriban|cleanse]] it of [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]].<ref name="kotor" /><ref name="sal" /> The planet became the sector headquarters of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]] visited the planet on their quest to discover the [[Star Forge]]<ref name="kotor" /> and then took control of the academy and made Korriban the public capital of their [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|empire]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> After losing his memory and getting replaced by Malak as the Dark Lord of the Sith, Revan again visited and infiltrated the academy<ref name="kotor" /> in [[3956 BBY]]<ref name="nec" /> on his quest to re-discover the Star Forge. Seeking the [[Star Map]] in [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|Naga Sadow's tomb]], he passed the tests and then confronted [[Uthar Wynn]], the academy's headmaster. With the death of Wynn, and Darth Malak himself at the hands of Revan<ref name="kotor" /> in [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="nec" /> the Sith collapsed into a [[Sith Civil War|civil war]]<ref name="tsl" /> (which took place [[3956 BBY|3956]]-[[3950 BBY]]),<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> during which all the Sith on Korriban either died or fled to other planets, leaving Korriban abandoned once more.<ref name="tsl" />

In [[3955 BBY]] or [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="date"> In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', Kreia says that after the Jedi Civil War, it took the Republic "a year or two" to send a force to Korriban, and ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' says that the Jedi Civil War ended in 3956 BBY.</ref> the Republic [[Expedition to Korriban|sent a force to Korriban]] to deal with any remaining Sith, but found none.<ref name="tsl" />

After the [[Sith Civil War]], the ancient tombs within the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] were plundered by grave-robbers. Many broken, charred corpses littered the plains of Korriban during this time, virtually all that remained of the Sith who once inhabited the world. However, their malignant spirits remained, ready to confront any who disturb their rest by way of their guardian-familiars, the [[Hssiss]].<ref name="tsl" />

[[File:Korribanlandscape.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]]]]
During the [[First Jedi Purge]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lonna Vash]] hid from the [[Sith Triumvirate]] on Korriban. Sith Lord [[Darth Sion]] trapped and killed Vash in the ruins of the academy and then used her as bait to lure [[Meetra Surik]] into his hands. After [[Duel in the Korriban Academy (First Jedi Purge)|escaping]] the trap, Surik discovered the long lost [[Tomb of Ludo Kressh|tomb]] of [[Ludo Kressh]].<ref name="tsl" />

===Great Galactic War===
{{Quote|After a thousand years&hellip; Korriban is ours again!|[[Darth Malgus]]|audio=KorribanIsOursAgain-TOR.flac|<ref name="Return (cinematic trailer)">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sith_seize_Korriban.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Sith reclaim Korriban.]]
In the aftermath of the Jedi Civil War, a fleet of Republic ships remained to guard the abandoned Sith world of Korriban. This remained until the onset of the [[Great Galactic War]], when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]] emerged and began conquering worlds in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] as well as ambushed the Republic fleet in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], as part of the Emperor's plan.<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> In the millennium since the Great Hyperspace War, the Empire had lost the location of Korriban, but they regained it when Revan and Malak visited the Sith Empire.<ref name="Korriban">{{Holonet|planets|korriban|Korriban}}</ref>

In order to bolster their forces, the Republic pulled many of their ships to support the fleet which left only a small number of Jedi security ships to patrol Korriban. This action, however, had already been predicted and played right into the Emperor's hand. As the conflict continued, the Sith, knowing that the Republic Forces on Korriban were weakened significantly, staged an [[Battle of Korriban|assault]] against the guarding ships and destroyed them thus returning the planet to Sith control, just as the Emperor planned, before the Jedi Council became aware of the incident.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

Retaking Korriban had been a top priority for the Sith Empire, when it re-emerged during the Great Galactic War. After retaking the planet, they re-established the Sith Academy.<ref name="Korriban" />

===Cold War===
{{Quote|Korriban, the birthplace of my power. I arrived as a Sith Acolyte, trained in the dark side; now, an apprentice to a Sith Lord. My rage has purpose. I will hunt the Jedi and destroy the Galactic Republic.|Unnamed [[Sith Warrior]]|<ref name="Sith Warrior trailer">{{TORYouTube|qkC2h6hIsio|STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - Class Video - Sith Warrior|site_url=info/media/trailers/sith-warrior}}</ref>}}
[[File:Korriban_TOR_New.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Korriban during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].]]
In the years after the Treaty of Coruscant, Korriban had become a major center of learning for the Sith Empire, the Sith Empire had seemingly built upon the tombs and the former Dreshdae, as well as uncovering many lost tombs and caverns.<ref name="TOR" />

At some point all Acolytes went through training here, seeking to become an apprentice to a Sith Lord or Darth, the typically brutal trials increased, often becoming trials where only one out of numerous Acolytes could possibly survive, the death count was astronomical.<ref name="TOR" />

The long practice of murder and betrayal among Sith had become illegal among Acolytes, even punishable by death, this did not mean such things did not take place though, as Acolytes would typically lay traps and ambushes in the tombs or caverns to remove challengers and potential threats, often placing blame on the beasts and crazed denizens of those same tombs.<ref name="TOR" />

Eventually the Sith Empire had become desperate in their search to replace those lost on the battlefield, allowing Force-sensitive slaves, captured Jedi and even aliens the opportunity to become acolytes and possibly join the Sith, becoming an apprentice.<ref name="TOR" />

At some point, two powerful beings, the [[Empire's Wrath|Unidentified Sith Warrior]] and the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Aloysius Kallig|Kallig's]] [[Darth Nox|descendant]] came to Korriban, though possibly not at the same time, and definitely not under the same circumstances, they would both pass their trials at exceptional speeds and become fully fledged Sith apprentices. They would then change galactic history, with one gaining a seat on the [[Dark Council]] and the other gaining the title of [[Emperor's Wrath]].<ref name="TOR" />

Some of the [[Imperial soldier]]s stationed there were corrupted by the planet's dark energies and went psychotic, attacking their own comrades or everyone else that wasn't equally corrupted.<ref name="TOR" />

===Galactic War===
[[File:Korriban_Incursion_concept_art.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Korriban Incursion]]
Soon a [[Galactic War|new war]] began between the Republic and the Sith Empire. In [[3637 BBY]], the Republic [[Korriban Incursion|invaded]] Korriban and held the Sith Academy for a short time. The attack was planned by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rian Darok]] and [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] Agent [[Theron Shan]]. However Darok was secretly a member of the [[Order of Revan]], and the attack was merely a means for the Revanites to obtain [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] technology from the Academy. A [[Assault on Tython|simultaneous attack]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] was perpetrated by Darok's secret ally, the Dark Councilor [[Darth Arkous]].<ref name="TOR" />

At some point during the Rise of the Eternal Empire, Korriban's many temples were reduced to rubble from bombardment by the Zakuul Fleet for the Sith's unwillingness to bend the knee. Though it would be later rebuilt, many ancient artifacts were left buried beneath the sands.<ref name="TOR" />

===New Sith Wars===
{{Quote|Korriban is the ancestral home of the Sith. It is a place of great power; the dark side lives and breathes in the very core of this world.|[[Qordis]] to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="pod" />}}
[[File:Lord_Kaan_EGF.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Skere Kaan]], ruler of Korriban at the end of the [[New Sith Wars]]]]
After capturing Korriban from the Republic in a [[Battle of Korriban (New Sith Wars)|brutal battle]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] operated a Sith Academy on the planet. Trainees from the Sith Academy were highly regarded for their potential; those who graduated were reputed as the most powerful Sith Lords amongst the Brotherhood. Such apprentices included a young [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], who went on to become a Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="pod" />

===Clone Wars and the Galactic Empire===
In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], a Sith Cultist by the name of [[Granta Omega]] tried to contact the remaining Sith Lord (or lords) in the galaxy. Although he did meet with the unknown Sith, Omega was [[Mission to Korriban (23 BBY)|killed]] by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], though not before Omega killed [[Darra Thel-Tanis]].<ref name="JQTFS" />

The world remained desolate until it was taken over by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] just prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], c. 24 BBY. Other than Guild employees, the planet was mostly inhabited by those who were unfortunate enough to end up on Korriban and have no way offworld.<ref name="JQTFS" /> [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] led a Republic force to Korriban during the early stages of the war, and the [[Battle of Korriban (Clone Wars)|battle]] cost the lives of many [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]].<ref name="WildSpace" />

At some point during the Clone Wars, fallen Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Tol Skorr]] raced to find [[Holocron of Heresies|Darth Andeddu's holocron]] for Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Vos won by allowing a [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]] to scare Skorr off. As a reward, Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] gave Andeddu's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] crystal to Vos.<ref name="Star Wars Republic 63: Striking from the Shadows">[[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]]</ref>

At some point near the end of the Clone Wars, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was sent on a [[Mission to Moraband/Legends|mission to Korriban]], now alternatively known as Moraband, by the spirit of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to finish the work he had started to discover the secret to immortality. While there, the [[Force Priestesses/Legends|Force Priestesses]] tested Yoda with illusions of [[Sith snake]]s, Sith warriors, and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], but Yoda realized that they were illusions, passing the tests. Afterwards, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] tried to "break" Yoda and make the Grand Master turn to the dark side. They placed in front of him visions of [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] and a cliffhanger duel with the two Sith Lords alongside [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Although the experience was harrowing for him, Yoda was able to defeat the visions that were laid out in front of him.<ref name="Sacrifice (ep)" />

During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], former Jedi turned bounty hunter [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] followed his bounty, [[Resk]], to Korriban. After beheading Resk, Hett was called by the spirit of the ancient Sith Lord, [[XoXaan]], who taught him the secrets of the ancient Sith.<ref name="leg17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>

[[File:Korriban_TEA.jpg|thumb||left|300px|Korriban]]
Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine,<ref name="SWGamer5">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> as Darth Sidious was now known,<ref name="Sidious DB">{{DB|character|darthsidious|Sidious, Darth}}</ref> visited the tombs of the ancient Sith Lords on Korriban that were still haunted by the ghosts of the long deceased Sith. He wanted to gain further knowledge of the dark side, but his demands only enraged the mummified Sith. Wounded and cowed, [[Jeng Droga]] rescued him and he had to recover from the assault in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while Droga retrieved one of Palpatine's clones from [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="SWGamer5" /> Palpatine mentioned the encounter in his annotations of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]' account of his meeting with the ancient Dark Lord of the Sith [[Marka Ragnos]] before Palpatine added the piece to his religious compendium, the ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BoS" />

[[File:PIE_1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] attacks the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on Korriban.]]
During this time, the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] had the option of setting up operations on the planet for knowledge.<ref name="Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>
During a pilgrimage to Korriban shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Emperor Palpatine suffered an [[Battle of Korriban (Galactic Civil War)|ambush]] from the Rebel Alliance's [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]]. After trapping Palpatine in one of the tombs temporarily, and suffering casualties in doing so, the Squadron were able to infiltrate his landing craft and obtain information about the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], information that would bring about the tyrant's [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fall]].<ref name="BRS" />

A [[Tomb of Darth Vader|throne]] intended for Palpatine's apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], was presumably erected sometime during this period.<ref name="EE 2" />

===New Republic===
{{Quote|Emperor of numberless worlds... Lord Vader's throne still remains empty. Have you now come to take his place and join us?|A [[Unidentified Dark Lord (Great Temple)|Dark Lord of the Sith]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="EE 2" />}}
[[File:VadersThrone-EE2P5.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Palpatine speaking to the Dark Lords of the Sith in the Great Temple]]
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="nec" /> the reborn Emperor Palpatine visited the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]] on Korriban seeking counsel from the spirits of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] predecessors in order to restore his decaying [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body. As they traveled through the ancient Sith crypt, the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[T'iaz]] felt the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] power emanating from the temple. Palpatine explained to him that the ancient Dark Lords were preserved by the [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] that made them outcasts. [[Unidentified Dark Lord (Great Temple)|One Dark Lord]] doubted his success and offered him Vader's throne, but Palpatine declined and instead demanded to be healed. The spirit suggested that Palpatine to gaze into the [[oracle stone]], through which Palpatine learned that the only way for him to survive would to to [[Essence transfer|transfer his spirit]] into [[Anakin Solo]], the newborn son of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The other spirits gave Palpatine counsel and bid him farewell for a final time. Palpatine did not succeed in his attempt to do so, and [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|lost his final clone body]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] shortly after.<ref name="EE 2" />

Shortly after the defeat of the reborn Emperor, [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] warned the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that many of the Emperor's adepts who evaded death or capture may have escaped to the Sith worlds to study in lost fortresses or libraries. She suggested that an expedition to search the tombs of Korriban was a starting place for investigating.<ref>{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>  

[[File:BattleofKorribanCultists.jpg|thumb|300px|The [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Battle of Korriban]], part of the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]]]]
In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]<ref name="nec" /> a cult known as the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] arrived on Korriban under the leadership of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tavion Axmis]]<ref name="jk-ja" /> of the [[Empire Reborn]],<ref name="dfs" /> hoping to resurrect the ancient Dark Lord of the Sith Marka Ragnos. However, their plans were being slowly uncovered by several Jedi, most notably by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Kyle Katarn]], and his two students: [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Rosh Penin]]. Eventually, the trails led the Jedi to Korriban. The [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Battle of Korriban]] concluded when Jaden Korr defeated Marka Ragnos's spirit in Tavion's body. Following Axmis' defeat, [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial support]] was withdrawn and the Disciples crumbled.<ref name="jk-ja" />

Years later, Hett finally emerged from his long tutelage under XoXaan, intent on defeating Palpatine and Vader, only to learn that they had already been defeated and were now dead. Realizing he went through all that for nothing, he escaped into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], determined to lose himself, where he met the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="leg18">[[Legacy (2006) 18|''Legacy'' (2006) 18]]</ref>

The [[New Jedi Order]] also revisited the planet on other occasions. At one time, Luke Skywalker sent some Jedi Academy researchers to Korriban, where they discovered the logs of the ''[[Jynni's Virtue]]''. The time codes on the log indicated it was recorded just before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], however they were found sealed in a 7,000 -year-old tomb.<ref name="wizards" />

===Rule of the One Sith===
[[File:Korribankrayt.png|thumb|left|300px|[[Darth Krayt]] on Korriban during the last years of the New Republic.]]
Korriban was apparently untouched by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Having [[Escape of A'Sharad Hett|escaped]] from the Yuuzhan Vong, A'Sharad returned to Korriban and renamed himself Darth Krayt, creating a new Sith Order known as the [[One Sith]] at some point by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. The new Sith would use Korriban as their headquarters, and would remain relatively hidden, acting behind the shadows like Palpatine did, before [[Sith–Imperial War|emerging]] from hiding a [[127 ABY|century later]].<ref name="leg18">[[Legacy (2006) 18|''Legacy'' (2006) 18]]</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Alema Rar]] went to Korriban to train under the Sith in order to help [[Darth Caedus]] focus himself after the death of Lumiya. Alema Rar met the Sith where after some persuasion was allowed to stay for a little while. Alema trained there and received [[Holocron of Darth Vectivus|Darth Vectivus's holocron]] filled with useless data to give to Jacen. They did not believe Jacen was essential to their plan and ultimately believed he would fail as he was not strong enough. Alema disagreed and believed these Sith were hiding while Caedus, a true Sith, took hold of the galaxy. The next year, [[Kell Douro]], an [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] spy working for the One Sith, traveled to Korriban and met up with [[Darth Wyyrlok (I)|Darth Wyyrlok]].

Some years before [[44 ABY]], Luke Skywalker had all navigation data about Korriban banned from Jedi computers, and had asked the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] to do the same. Despite this, enough information was found in ancient, locked-up records, allowing Luke, [[Ben Skywalker]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Vestara Khai]] to get to Korriban while looking for the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

In [[137 ABY]], Krayt returned to Korriban to demand to the ancient Sith Lords, [[Darth Nihilus]], [[Darth Andeddu]] and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] to give him the teachings to heal him or at least slow down the Vong growths on his body, but the ghosts refused to give him aid. Their magic caused the Vong armor he wore to make him into a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|creature much like his namesake]]. The current Dark Lord refused to accept his destiny and dispelled the magic.<ref name="Broken 4" />

Months later, when Krayt was [[Battle on Had Abbadon|defeated]] on [[Had Abbadon]] and assassinated by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], his body was entombed within the ancient [[XoXaan's Temple|Temple of XoXaan]], kept in a [[Stasis Room|stasis chamber]] so that the other Sith wouldn't suspect their master's demise. At the same time, [[Marasiah Fel]] was abducted and taken prisoner at the planet and [[Darth Maladi]] sent [[Darth Nihl]] to the planet to verify if Darth Krayt was still alive or if he was dead. The two Sith Lords had become disillusioned with Darth Wyyrlok's handling of the Order and the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]].

Following the final death of Darth Krayt at the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]] and the subsequent collapse of Krayt's Empire, all of the [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]] housed on Korriban went berserk and attempted to kill everyone around them. Those Sith that could, fled; those who could not were slain.<ref name="SWLG6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>

==Fauna==
[[File:Sith_hound.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tuk'ata in the Valley of the Dark Lords during the Funeral of Marka Ragnos.]]
Due to the planet's harsh terrain, and the power of the dark side, Korriban's native fauna was both vicious and cunning, such as the fierce [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]]. The bat-like [[Shyrack/Legends|shyracks]] lived in great numbers in caves on the planet. [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]], sometimes called Sith hounds were also fairly common, particularly in the Valley of the Dark Lords. [[Wraid]]s were also found on Korriban.<ref name="kotor" /> Dark side dragons, or [[Hssiss]], could be found on Korriban.<ref name="tsl" /> The highly venomous [[pelko bug]] was an insect native to the planet&mdash;its venom had a potent numbing effect and was used in [[Sith training saber]]s by the Brotherhood of Darkness near the end of the New Sith Wars.<ref name="pod" /> By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[K'lor'slug/Legends|K'lor'slugs]] could also be found on Korriban.<ref name="TOR" />

==Locations==
===Valley of the Dark Lords===
{{Main|Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends}}
[[File:ValleyOfTheDarkLords-EGTF.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Valley of the Dark Lords]]
The [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] was a valley and burial ground for the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] who ruled the Sith Empire before the Great Hyperspace War.<ref name="totj2" /> Originally constructed by the planet's natives as a burial ground for their kings;<ref name="BoS" /> the [[Exiles]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who came to be known as the Dark Lords of the Sith added their own tombs to the Valley.<ref name="JvS" /> Along with several prominent tombs,<ref name="kotor" /> the Valley was home to the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]]<ref name="dlots3" /> and [[Lord Khreusis's stronghold|Lord Khreusis's Stronghold]] which would loom over the Valley for several millennia.<ref name="TOR" />

===Sith Academy===
{{Main|Sith Academy (Korriban)}}
[[File:Sith_Academy_Entrance.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Sith Academy during the Jedi Civil War]]
The [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] was a facility in use since the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="TEA" /> dedicated to training Force sensitives in the ways of the Sith, and running archaeological projects in the Valley of the Dark Lords.<ref name="kotor" />

===Korriban Arrival Port===
{{Main|Korriban Arrival Port}}
The [[Korriban Arrival Port]] was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of Korriban during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was near the Academy and the Valley of the Dark Lords and was mostly used for shuttles to drop potential [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] who were then taken to the Academy. There, their respective training [[Overseer (Sith)|overseers]] would meet and brief them on the basics of [[Sith training]].<ref name="TOR" />

===Valley of Golg===
{{Main|Valley of Golg}}
The Valley of Golg was a burial valley constructed on Korriban by the Sith<ref name="wizards" /> before [[200,000 BBY]].<ref name="BoS" /> It was located near the planet's equator.<ref name="wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Without Adas' unifying influence, wars once again raged for rule of the Sith people, with the reigning combatants arrogantly claiming the title of Sith'ari, and eventually forcing a relocation of the Sith capitol to the planet Ziost. Eventually, almost two-dozen millennia after Adas' death, a proper successor to Adas seemed to come at last. Known in Republic space as the Exiles, traitorous Jedi defeated in a galactic war called the Hundred-Year Darkness arrived on Korriban and cowed the Sith people with their astounding Force abilities, lightsabers, and superior technology.|Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties on the history of Korriban and Ziost|<ref name="pena" />}}
[[File:Korriban_Valley_TOR.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Concept art of Korriban for ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'']]
Korriban first appeared in [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]. The name of the planet was conceived by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="Veitch Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsunderworld.com/2016/08/interview-with-dark-empire-writer-tom.html|text=Interview with ''Dark Empire'' Writer Tom Veitch|work=Star Wars Underworld|archivedate=20200613234534}}</ref>

Although [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] was established as the capital of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in ''[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3]]'',  the [[StarWars.com|starwars.com]] article "Architect of the Sith" referred to the Sith species as "the native inhabitants of Korriban,"<ref name="AOTS">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20000721.html|text=Architect of the Sith}}</ref> the [[Databank (original)|original starwars.com databank]] referred to the Sith species as "the indigenous people of Korriban,"<ref name="db" /> [[Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls]] referred to "the ancient Sith homeworld of Korriban,"<ref name="POLS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban1|series=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|text=Part 1: Haunted Hideout}}</ref> in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]], [[Deesra Luur Jada]] describes Korriban as "a dark world some believe to be the birthplace of the Sith" and [[Bastila Shan]] says, "There are some who believe Korriban is the birthplace of the Sith," and in [[Shadows and Light]], [[Cale Berkona]] refers to Korriban as "the Sith homeworld." This lead to confusion as to whether Korriban or Ziost was the homeworld of the Sith species. 

The article ''[[Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties]]'' by [[Abel G. Peña]] explained that the Sith species originated on Korriban and relocated to Ziost before the arrival of the [[Exiles|Dark Jedi Exiles]] after the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], although the Dark Jedi exiles themselves landed on Korriban.

In ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', entering the word "KORRIBAN" in the "Input Code" section unlocks the [[Sith stalker armor]].

In the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] is referred to as "the long-lost homeworld of the original Sith species"<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>, implying that the Sith species migrated to Korriban at some point before Adas was born. However, [[Drew Karpyshyn]], author of ''The Old Republic: Revan'', later stated that that may have been propaganda.<ref name="DrewDromund">{{Flickr|url=photos/53636980@N03/6449560549|text=DrewKDromundResponse|author=Drew Karpyshyn|date=2011-12-03|archivedate=20151027060021}}</ref>

Korriban is mentioned in "[[Destiny (The Clone Wars)|Destiny]]", an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'',<ref name="Destiny">{{TCW|Destiny (The Clone Wars)}}</ref> and appears in the following episode, "[[Sacrifice (episode)|Sacrifice]]".<ref name="Sacrifice (ep)" /> [[George Lucas]] preferred the name Moraband to Korriban during story development,<ref name="Sacrifice Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sacrifice-trivia-gallery|text="Sacrifice" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> leading "Destiny"<ref name="Destiny" /> and "Sacrifice" to refer to the planet as "Moraband".<ref name="Sacrifice (ep)" /> The "Sacrifice" episode guide's trivia gallery explained that Korriban could have had multiple names throughout its history, suggesting that both names were used in-universe.<ref name="Sacrifice Trivia" />

In [[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]],<ref name="EE 2" /> which is set in 11 ABY,<ref name="nec" /> Palpatine says, "It has been ten years since I last stood on this lost world" while on Korriban,<ref name="EE 2" /> but he goes to Korriban in ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]'', which is set in 4 ABY.<ref name="BRS" />
